title: Someone just opens the latch
situation: A man walks up to a police van holding detained protesters and opens its latch; several youths jump out and run. A young woman following the van claps.

lines.text: What they did with students in Delhi was wrong.
lines.speaker: young woman in the video

context: Police said 700 to 800 gathered, about 200 detained, officers showed restraint.

buildThis.situation: The detention bus rear latch is a usable object: open it while the guard chats with Sharma and detainees trickle out one by one.
